mentions.name: TableForge
mentions.description: A browser-based, solo or multiplayer D&D 5e game where the Dungeon Master is an agentic AI with access to tools strictly following 5e rules. The DM handles narration and reacts to players through deterministic 5e-based tools (dice rolls, damage, sheet updates, memory), while character sheets, inventory, and spells are real server resources players manage. Sessions can be played in real time or asynchronously, and the DM can flesh out a full campaign story arc from a provided or library-selected premise, generating a fresh story that reacts to actual player decisions.

mentions.name: Tableforge
mentions.description: An agentic AI game master for Dungeons & Dragons that handles setting up and running a 5e campaign, supporting both real-time and asynchronous play. The agent performs most functions through tool use so it stays 5e rules-based, while retaining freedom for campaigns to go on tangents and have fun surprises. Currently in early access and being playtested.
mentions.problem: Getting a D&D group together in person has been getting harder, and the group has had less and less time to DM.
mentions.source_excerpt: I decided to build an agentic AI to handle the work of setting up and running a campaign so we could all participate. It supports real time (preferred, and probably more fun) or async. The agent performs most functions through tool use so it's all 5e rules based
